settings.show_only_used_tags: Show only tags that have discussions
settings.show_tag_count: Show discussion count next to tag names
settings.external_stats_native_url_help: Direct OpenTracker stats URL returning XML. Example: http://IP:6969/stats?mode=everything
settings.external_stats_cache_ttl_help: How long fetched stats are considered fresh. During this window nobody hits the tracker — everyone is served from the shared cache. Default: 30s.
settings.external_stats_max_time_help: Time limit for a single fetch from the tracker. A large tracker can take ~a minute to compute stats — raise this if they don't finish loading. Only one worker fetches at a time. Default: 30s.
settings.external_stats_refresh_help: How often to refresh external tracker stats. Default: 5 seconds.
settings.search_debounce_ms_help: Delay before firing a search while typing. Higher = fewer requests. Default: 500ms
settings.ratelimit_enabled_help: Each visitor has a point budget for searching that refills over time, so casual use stays smooth but rapid spamming is stopped. When the budget runs out the IP is temporarily blocked (settings below).
settings.ratelimit_block_header: When points run out → temporary IP block
settings.ratelimit_start_help: Initial points given to each visitor. Default: 10
settings.ratelimit_refill_seconds_help: How often +N points are added back. Default: 15s
settings.ratelimit_refill_amount_help: How many points are added per interval. Default: 1
settings.ratelimit_guest_extra_help: Added to every action cost for non-logged-in visitors. Default: +2
settings.ratelimit_block_seconds_help: How long an IP stays blocked after running out of points. Points do not refill while blocked. Default: 60s
settings.ratelimit_block_reset_help: What the visitor's budget becomes once the IP block expires. "Full" is more forgiving; "empty" keeps them throttled (points then trickle back at the refill rate). During the block points never refill — it always lasts the full duration and is not lifted early.
settings.title_length_help: Title column is varchar(200). Min must be at least 1, max at most 200.
settings.content_length_help: Content column is mediumtext (up to 16 million chars). Set 0 to allow empty posts.
settings.theme_mode_help: Auto follows the forum's light / dark mode (including the header theme switcher). Light / Dark always use the forum's light or dark colours for the homepage blocks.
settings.style_help: Fitted blends the blocks into your forum's look. Original is a distinct card design — rounded cards with a soft shadow, a header tinted with your primary colour, stat tiles — built from your forum's own colours. Both follow light / dark mode.
settings.category_label_help: Leave empty to use the default translation.
settings.resolution_label_help: Leave empty to use the default translation.

whitelist.enabled_help: Every magnet link posted on the forum (new post, edit, approval) is registered on the tracker's whitelist through its server-to-server API. Requires tryhackx-tracker >= 1.2.0 in whitelist mode and PHP ext-curl.
whitelist.api_url_help: Base URL of the tracker web app, e.g. https://tracker.example.org (http/https only, no trailing path).
whitelist.api_key_id_help: The 16-character key ID shown when the API client was created in the tracker admin panel (Whitelist → API clients).
whitelist.api_secret_help: Paste the secret (or the whole key_id.secret token) and press Save secret. It is stored server-side only and never sent back to the browser.
whitelist.secret_not_set: No secret stored yet — sync is inactive.
whitelist.secret_error: Could not save the secret (invalid value or request failed).
whitelist.timeout_help: Per-request timeout for the live sync during post saves (1–10 s, default 3). Failures never block the post.
whitelist.bare_hashes: Also detect bare 40-hex hashes in posts
whitelist.bare_hashes_help: Off by default: on a security forum bare 40-hex strings are usually git commits or SHA-1 IOCs, not torrents. Magnet links and btih: fragments are always detected.
whitelist.require_tracker: Only sync magnets that point at our tracker
whitelist.require_tracker_help: Off by default. When on, a hash is sent only if its magnet link lists one of the hosts below in a tr= (announce) parameter. Bare btih: fragments and bare 40-hex hashes have no tracker and are skipped.
whitelist.tracker_hosts_help: Hostnames or IPs of your tracker, comma / newline separated (host:port and full URLs are accepted; matched case-insensitively). Leave empty and nothing will be sent — the last-error line reports it.
whitelist.describe: Send topic descriptions to the tracker
whitelist.describe_help: Off by default. Once the magnets of a topic's first post are synced, that post's text (exactly as the author typed it), its author, link and last edit time go to the tracker, which uses it as the description of those torrents — held for its moderators or published at once, as set for this API key on the tracker. Replies are never sent; a post awaiting approval is sent once it is approved. The forum's own content length limit (Content Settings, or core's 63,000 characters while that override is off) is sent along; a post longer than it goes without its text. Needs tryhackx-tracker 1.78.0 or newer with "Descriptions from the forum" on for this key. Scan whole forum sends and refreshes descriptions too.
whitelist.image_copy: Let the tracker copy pictures from posts
whitelist.image_copy_help: Off by default. When on, the tracker keeps its own copies of the forum's pictures (from the image domains set for this API key on the tracker) and swaps their addresses in the descriptions it holds. When off, the tracker shows them from the forum's addresses. The tracker copies only while both sides agree. A change reaches the tracker with the next sync, or right away after saving or a Test connection.
whitelist.describe_all_help: Walks the first post of every topic (visible and approved), registers its magnets first and then sends its description again — one request per batch, resumable, like Scan whole forum. Texts the tracker already has come back as unchanged and write nothing; new or edited ones are created, updated or queued, as set for this API key on the tracker. Needs the whitelist sync and "Send topic descriptions to the tracker" saved as on.
whitelist.describe_all_running: A forum scan or description batch is already running (another tab?). Try again in a moment.
whitelist.describe_all_disabled: Turn on the whitelist sync and "Send topic descriptions to the tracker", then save.
whitelist.describe_all_off: Descriptions are off on the tracker (for this key or as a whole) — stopped. Press Resume once Test connection shows them on.
whitelist.test_help: Calls the tracker's ping endpoint with the values above (unsaved secret is used if typed). Before testing, add this forum's outbound IP to the tracker's api_ban_exempt_ips — only the tracker's own addresses are exempt by default; a wrong key ID / secret gets the IP banned on the tracker for 30 days.
whitelist.test_ok: Connected — tracker mode {mode}, {count} hashes whitelisted, clock skew {skew}s, {ms} ms.
whitelist.test_forbidden_hint: Check the key ID / secret; the tracker may also have banned this server's IP (tracker admin → Whitelist → API bans).
whitelist.test_invalid_credentials_hint: Nothing was sent: the key ID must be 16 hex characters and the secret 64 hex characters (or one key_id.secret token).
whitelist.test_describe_unknown: Descriptions: not reported by the tracker (needs tryhackx-tracker 1.78.0 or newer).
whitelist.test_images_copy: Pictures: the tracker copies them to itself (domains: {domains}).
whitelist.test_images_off: Pictures: the tracker does not copy them (no image domains on the key).
whitelist.test_images_no_consent: Pictures: the tracker wants to copy them — tick the consent above and save.
whitelist.scan_help: Walks every visible post in batches (one request per batch, well inside the PHP time limit), extracts magnet links and pushes them to the tracker. Safe to re-run: existing hashes are reported as already registered. On a tracker error the batch is not skipped — press Resume.
whitelist.scan_progress: {processed}/{total} posts · {hashes} hashes found · skipped {skipped} (other tracker) · added {added} · existing {exists} · banned {banned}
whitelist.scan_progress_describe: Descriptions: accepted {described} · unchanged {unchanged} · kept {kept} (edited on the tracker) · too long {tooLong} · invalid {invalid} · skipped {skipped}
whitelist.scan_describe_off: Descriptions are off on the tracker (for this key or as a whole) — only magnets are synced. The forum tries again in 10 minutes, or right after a Test connection that shows them on.
whitelist.scan_done: Scan finished: {processed} posts, {hashes} hashes ({added} added, {exists} existing, {banned} banned).
whitelist.scan_running: A scan batch is already running (another tab?). Try again in a moment.
whitelist.scan_cooldown: The tracker client is in failure cooldown — check the connection, then Resume.
whitelist.scan_cancelled: Cancelled — press Resume to continue from the last batch.

advanced.enabled_help: Adds a collapsible "More filters" panel at the bottom right of the filters, plus optional extra fields and sorts. Every filter below can be switched on separately; nothing changes for the forum while this is off.
advanced.open_default_help: By default the panel is collapsed on every visit and opens only when "More filters" is clicked.
advanced.meta_badge_help: Read from the discussion's title and first post — needs the index below.
advanced.filter_type_help: An All / Movies / Series switch next to "More filters" (or a list in the main row / the panel). Series are recognised from the post: a kind field (e.g. "Serial: TV Series"), seasons / episodes or S01E01 markers.
advanced.filter_size_help: From – to in MB / GB / TB, from the magnet's exact length, a "Size:" line or the title.
advanced.filter_year_help: From – to. A series or a trilogy matches when its years overlap the range.
advanced.filter_duration_help: From – to in minutes (an average episode for a series).
advanced.filter_rating_help: 0–5 from Topic Rating. Unrated discussions never match.
advanced.filter_created_help: From – to date (older / newer than). Days follow the visitor's own time zone.
advanced.filter_active_help: From – to date of the newest post.
advanced.filter_magnet_help: Only discussions with (or without) a magnet link.
advanced.filter_steam_help: From – to in % (0–100) — the confidence-weighted score of the "Steam DB rating" sort. Unrated discussions never match.
advanced.filter_rated_help: From – to date of the newest rating.
advanced.filter_clicks_help: All magnets of the discussion together, from – to.
advanced.filter_clicks_top_help: Clicks of the most clicked magnet, from – to.
advanced.filter_clicked_help: From – to date of the newest magnet click.
advanced.type_placement_help: Button = an All / Movies / Series switch next to "More filters"; main row = a list between Resolution and Direction.
advanced.parser_header: How release data is read from posts
advanced.parser_help: The index reads each discussion's title and first post as plain text (BBCode / Markdown removed). A field counts where a line or a ", " segment starts with one of the labels below, followed by a colon. Leave a field empty to use the default shown in it. After changing anything here: Save, then rebuild the index.
advanced.size_sources_help: Tried in this order; the first one found wins. The magnet length counts only when every magnet in the post has one (they are added up).
advanced.labels_help: Comma separated, case-insensitive, matched literally (not as patterns).
advanced.label_kind_labels: Kind field (its value says series or not)
advanced.series_from_counts: …it has a seasons value or 2+ episodes
advanced.series_from_pattern: …the title or post contains S01E01-style markers
advanced.seasons_from_pattern: No seasons label → count seasons from the highest S01E01 marker
advanced.index_help: Index-based filters and sorts read this table. It is kept up to date automatically when discussions are started, their first post is edited or they are renamed; build it once after enabling, and again after changing the rules above.
advanced.status_error: Could not load the index status.
advanced.status_line: Indexed: {indexed} of {total} discussions · with a size: {size} · series: {series} · movies: {movies}
advanced.status_missing: Not indexed yet: {count} — rebuild the index.
advanced.status_stale: Indexed with older rules: {count} — rebuild to apply the current ones.
advanced.status_ok: The index is complete and current.
advanced.status_not_kept: No index-based filter or sort is enabled, so new discussions aren't indexed right now.
advanced.save_first: You have unsaved changes — save them first, the rebuild uses the saved settings.
advanced.rebuild_running: A rebuild is already running (another tab?) — try again in a moment.
advanced.rebuild_error: The rebuild stopped with an error — Resume continues where it stopped.
advanced.rebuild_cancelled: Stopped. Resume continues where it stopped.
advanced.rebuild_cli: Large forum? The same from the shell, without time limits: php flarum homepage-blocks:reindex (add --only-stale for missing / outdated only).

forum.rate_limited: Too many actions in a short time. Please try again in {seconds}s.
